boundary: before first scientific teacher update and model-generated corpus

teacher.selection: minimum pooled gold-trace NLL; earliest tie, including0

corpus.eos: first actual EOS; no forced EOS
corpus.sampling_rng: separate SHA256(seed:parent_id) stream for each prompt
corpus.retention: save all256; structural eligibility for student targets; never regenerate rejects

student.selection: maximum dev greedy exact final-answer accuracy; earliest tie including0
student.initial_state: one shared fresh TinyLM state per seed across all arms
student.soft: full teacher distribution at copied eligible prefixes, forwardKL,T1
student.answer: copied final integer plusEOS; different length/conditioning recipe
student.verified: all arithmetic steps and final answer correct; changed support/weights

loss_reduction: pooled selected response positions per minibatch; EOS included
test_rule: all15 terminal student outcomes then selection seal then once per selected model/split
evaluation: full-vocabulary greedy cap12; exact grammar/final/step measures and format-specific reference NLL
display_rule: first two test families in frozen order, all four c; first two invalid/wrong corpus IDs in sorted order
failure_rule: retain all failures/empty outcomes; no outcome-driven hyperparameter or seed changes
native_route: separate prospective protocol; not a dependency of these seven scientific files
